jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Overview This is a remote role that may be hired in the following states: California, New York, Massachusetts, North Carolina At First Citizens Bank, we believe meaningful careers are built through meaningful relationships. For more than 125 years, we've supported our clients, communities and colleagues through a culture rooted in connection, collaboration and long-term success. The Enterprise Marketing team is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Marcom Central responsible for the strategy, governance, adoption, and continuous improvement of the Marcom Central platform. This position is accountable for maximizing the value of the platform through effective product management, stakeholder engagement, platform optimization, and roadmap execution. Reporting to the Marketing Risk Governance and Tools leader, this role serves as the business owner for Marcom Central platform capabilities, related assets, and print fulfillment. Responsibilities & Qualifications Duties & Responsibilities: Lead all phases of the Marcom Central product lifecycle, including strategy, planning, design, development, implementation, and optimization. Define and maintain the product roadmap aligned with business objectives. Develop business requirements, user stories, and functional specifications. Serve as the primary business owner and subject matter expert for Marcom Central. Manage platform governance, taxonomy standards, metadata frameworks, user permissions, and asset lifecycle processes. Evaluate market trends, marketing technology innovations, and customer needs to inform product strategy. Monitor platform utilization and user engagement metrics to drive continuous improvement. Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Compliance, Legal, Technology, and Operations. Lead training, change management, and user adoption initiatives. Governance & Execution In partnership with Marketing Risk Governance, establish governance standards and operating procedures for Marcom Central digital assets and platform administration. Maintain Marcom Central asset governance processes, audits, metadata management, and lifecycle controls. Manage vendor relationships and coordinate issue resolution. Develop reporting and analytics to measure adoption, usage, and business value. Facilitate cross-functional meetings and communicate roadmap progress to leadership. Preferred Skills: 7-10 years of experience in product management, marketing operations, DAM, content management, or marketing technology. Experience managing enterprise software or marketing platforms. Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to influence and build consensus across large organizations. Experience with Marcom Central or similar DAM/MRM platforms. Experience in financial services or other regulated industries. Experience supporting print-on-demand and collateral fulfillment workflows. MBA, Master's degree, or Product Management certification preferred. Additional Information If hired in California, New York or Massachusetts the base pay for this position is generally between $98,282.61 and, $135,000. Actual starting base pay will be determined based on skills, experience, location, and other non-discriminatory factors permitted by law. For some roles, total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other awards as outlined in the offer of employment. Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Director Digital Product Management (Remote - NY)
jobs.description: Overview This is a remote role that may only be hired in New York. This position is responsible for leading the digital product strategy, development, and lifecycle management of First Citizens Bank's Commercial Digital Banking platforms and experiences across online and mobile channels. The role provides strategic leadership for a portfolio of commercial digital solutions while driving innovation, modernization, and client-centric experiences that support the evolving needs of business and commercial clients. This role drives innovation, aligns product development with business objectives, and oversees a team of product managers to deliver high-impact digital solutions that enhance customer experience and drive business growth. This position shapes the long-term vision for digital products, influences C-suite decisions, and ensures that the product organization delivers significant business value and competitive advantage through innovative commercial digital solutions. Responsibilities & Qualifications Minimum Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's Degree and 10 years' experience OR High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 14 years' experience in Digital product management, strategic planning, digital transformation Preferred Education:Master's Degree / MBA Preferred Area of Study:Business Administration, Computer Science, or related field Preferred Area of Experience:Multi-industry experience, proven track record of digital innovation Enterprise Digital Commercial Strategy - Define and drive the long-term digital product vision and strategy for key domains across a portfolio of commercial digital solutions across First Citizens. Lead transformative digital initiatives that significantly impact business operations and growth. Collaborate with C-suite executives to align digital product strategy with corporate objectives. Innovation and Emerging Technologies - Spearhead research and adoption of cutting-edge technologies in digital product development. Drive the creation of new digital business models and revenue streams. Foster a culture of innovation and experimentation across the product organization. Organizational Leadership - Oversee multiple commercial digital product teams across the organization. Develop and implement strategies to build a world-class digital product organization. Mentor and develop the next generation of product leaders Strategic Partnerships and Influence - Influence senior executives and align stakeholders around strategic priorities. Build and maintain relationships with key partners across Business, Core Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, Security, and Design teams. Lead complex, cross-enterprise initiatives and drive decision making across multiple stakeholder groups. Build and maintain strategic partnerships with key technology vendors and industry leaders. Represent the organization as a thought leader in digital product management. Influence industry standards and best practices in digital product development Performance and Risk Management - Establish and monitor enterprise-wide metrics for digital product success. Oversee risk management strategies for digital products, including security and compliance. Drive continuous improvement in product development processes and methodologies Position Specific Skills: Strategic Thinking Leadership Enterprise / commercial digital strategy Emerging technologies and market trends Organizational change management Executive-level influence and communication Digital ecosystem development Performance and Risk Management - Establish and monitor enterprise-wide metrics for digital product success. Oversee risk management strategies for digital products, including security and compliance. Drive continuous improvement in product development processes and methodologies The base pay for this position is generally between $210,000 and $290,000. jobs.title: Senior MDM Product Analyst
jobs.description: Overview The Senior MDM Product Analyst – Informatica 360 is responsible for driving the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Master Data Management (MDM) solutions across the organization. This role provides strategic leadership for MDM platforms, focusing on end-to-end data architecture, scalable integrations, and real-time data enablement. The candidate will lead the implementation of Informatica Customer 360 and Reference 360, ensuring seamless data flow from source systems to downstream consumers. This role requires deep expertise in API-driven and event-driven architectures, data pipeline engineering (batch and real-time), and enterprise integration patterns—enabling a governed, unified, and high-quality customer data ecosystem across banking platforms Responsibilities & Qualifications Duties & Responsibilities: Data Enhancement - Leads the implementation of enhancements for the quality, management, and storage of enterprise data. Executes initiatives that improve profiling, exception reporting, and issue resolution as well as general fixes for the Enterprise Data Warehouse. Builds dashboards to modernize analytics and assists management with special data projects. Business Support - Enforces data policies and procedures across the enterprise. Encourages discussion and feedback from associates in order to identify areas of improvement within data management capabilities. Completes month-end validations on reporting data to ensure the quality and completeness of data prior to business use. May assist in training or mentoring less experienced consultants in the work group. Business Strategy - Facilitates strategies that develop the Bank’s data management capabilities. Assists management in creating and implementing a strategic road to achieve planned objectives. Works cross-functionally to mature department presence within Bank business units. Maintains a strong knowledge of current and emerging technologies or trends impacting the financial service industry. Documentation - Creates and maintains technical documentation for the Enterprise Data Warehouse, which includes source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, and other related materials. Identifies and creates centralized business critical reports. Position Specific Skills: Understanding of data warehousing and transformation methods, lineage documentation, and ETL processes Knowledge of data spreadsheets and databases Understanding of Base SAS programming, SAS Enterprise Guide, Cognos, or related programs Ability to write SAS programming language Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree and 6 years of experience in Data Management, Data Analytics OR High School Diploma or GED and 10 years of experience in Data Management, Data Analytics Core MDM Expertise 12+ years of experience in data engineering, MDM development, or integration architecture. Experience working in Agile methodology, including writing user stories and test cases using Jira. Deep expertise in Customer/Party MDM (Individual & Non-Individual), golden record management, and match & merge frameworks. Strong background in the Finance/Banking domain. Platforms & Tools Strong hands-on experience with Informatica Customer 360 & Reference 360 (mandatory; SaaS preferred). Familiarity with other MDM tools such as Reltio, IBM MDM (preferred). Strong proficiency in SQL and data integration tools (Informatica, ETL frameworks). Experience with API development (REST, GraphQL) and messaging/event platforms (Kafka, MQ, etc.). Experience building controls on data environments. Data & Architecture Strong understanding of data modeling (logical & physical), data integration patterns, data governance, and data lineage. Proven experience designing real-time and batch data architectures. Cloud & Data Platforms Experience with Snowflake or other cloud data platforms (preferred). Exposure to Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud architecture. Domain Knowledge Experience in banking or financial services, including familiarity with Core Banking, Customer Information Systems, and Fraud/Risk/Compliance (KYC preferred). Leadership & Soft Skills Strong technical leadership and mentoring ability. Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills. Ability to lead enterprise-scale initiatives independently. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in large-scale enterprise data transformation programs. Knowledge of microservices architecture and domain-driven design. Exposure to DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks. KEY DELIVERABLES ▸ MDM architecture and integration designs ▸ End-to-end data pipeline frameworks ▸ API and event-driven data services ▸ Informatica 360 platform configurations and implementations ▸ Data models and integration mappings ▸ Performance optimization and monitoring frameworks Additional Information Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits.
